key_insight: TEA-Prompt preserves a shared prompt’s attention behavior rather than freezing its parameters, enabling adaptation to new classes while reducing forgetting.
engineering_relevance: The approach may support memory-efficient continual adaptation of engineering vision systems, but the abstract does not demonstrate solid mechanics or constitutive modeling applications.
method: Adapt a frozen vision transformer using one shared prompt.
Softly specialize prompt tokens with input-dependent relevance scores injected into attention logits.
Anchor attention outputs using compact class-specific Gaussian query statistics, weighted by past token relevance, without storing old images.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports state-of-the-art accuracy and markedly lower forgetting on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-R, and CUB-200 with only 0.38M parameters.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify accuracy gains or test whether Gaussian query statistics remain adequate under engineering-domain shifts.
paper_title: Anchor Behavior, Not Parameters: Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning with a Single Shared Prompt
